string: LuminAAC uses your location only for safe zones your parent turned on, to tell your family when you arrive or leave.
So your family still gets "arrived" and "left" notes when LuminAAC is closed. Location goes only to your family's own LuminAAC server.
To scan the pairing code and, if you choose, to record moments. Videos stay on this device.
To record moments and, if you choose, estimate feelings from voice. Recordings stay on this device.
